svg.text: Two ribs, both 60 mm wide plus a tab each side: rib A (at 800 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rear axle, left in the sketch) 197 mm tall, rib B (at 900 mm) 233 mm tall.

svg.text: Each long edge: two tabs into the side plate slots and one T-slot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: between them for an M8 bolt from outside the spine.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: T-slot: 9 mm wide, 23 deep, with a 13.6 x 8.4 mm window 10 mm in for the nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the ribs stand square across the spine, 5 mm clear of both covers.
